task: Complete P4 Advanced Arena user-facing functionality on top of the existing algorithm slice. Implement a usable desktop UI integrated into the existing Arena view (or a clearly reachable Advanced Arena surface) for rankings by category/metric, regression comparison workflows, Tournament Mode with 1v1, blind ranking and round-robin/single-elimination scheduling, optional offline AI-judge score entry with explicit provenance/network-off boundary, calibration and disagreement handling. Reuse existing immutable Arena summaries/evidence and bridge contracts where possible; persist user-created advanced results only through existing app-owned durable storage or add a bounded migration/command if needed. No network calls, no secrets, no page-transition motion, no scaffold/foundation copy. Preserve existing Core Arena behavior and accessibility. Add focused tests for all new interaction/validation paths and update any existing tests as needed.
constraints: All implementation is performed in this BL4 app_server session using account biel4 and role Executor/Reviewer.
The Advanced Arena surface is reachable from normal navigation and is usable in the real desktop UI, with loading/empty/error/success states and keyboard labels.
Rankings expose quality/latency/throughput/human categories, explicit metric direction and insufficient-data/tie handling.
Regression workflow compares baseline and candidate with improved/regressed/tie/insufficient-data outcomes and sample counts.
Tournament scheduler exposes 1v1, blind ranking, round-robin and single-elimination choices, bounded competitor count/matches, byes and a transparent schedule.
AI judge is optional, accepts bounded offline/manual scores only, labels source and explicitly states no network was used; invalid/disagreement cases are visible.
Calibration displays agreement rate, MAE, bias and disagreement samples with insufficient-data handling.
Existing npm typecheck/test/build and Rust fmt/check/test pass; add focused tests for the P4 surface/helpers.
Commit only this P4 user-facing slice with a descriptive message; do not alter prior commits or publish anything.

review_findings.title: P4 user-facing Advanced Arena remains incomplete
review_findings.details: Implement the requested end-to-end UI and durable integration without broadening into P5/P6/P7.
